Do not copy other objects from the style reference. Additional references provide character or material consistency only; include only the subject specified in the asset prompt. No clock face, ticks, numbers or additional hand. Use 1024x1024 aspect ratio. 

ASSET PROMPT (verbatim):
Bright bold-outlined cartoon video game UI art: thick dark outlines around every shape, saturated candy colours, paper and cardboard textures, slightly scrappy handmade low-budget film-production props, simple flat shading, crisp readable shapes. A single short cardboard clock hand pointing straight up, with a round pivot at the bottom end. Exactly one item, centred, filling about 80 percent of a square canvas, isolated on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame, no scenery, no cast shadow.
